change_log.rationale: The staged return-components calibration contract now exposes raw observed open-session returns, activity-lift evidence, and explicit objective weights so callers provide empirical evidence instead of pre-baked NIG candidates and forced jump structure.

change_log.rationale: Seeded simulation now returns lazy fine-path and event-tape views with explicit boundary diagnostics, replacing the eager full-path JSON round-trip and surfacing the new response metadata in the approved Python API snapshot.
change_log.summary: Record lazy seeded simulation views and boundary diagnostics in the public Python API snapshot.

change_log.rationale: Market-data calibration now resolves sessions automatically when a common workflow provides enough evidence, so the public calibration contracts expose optional session overrides plus a surfaced session-resolution artifact that can be reused for calibration and simulation preparation.
change_log.summary: Expose automatic session resolution diagnostics and make manual session-definition inputs optional.

change_log.rationale: The high-level calibration surface now exposes typed session, known-news, and market-profile preset references with explicit override patches and full explicit configuration payloads, replacing any need for ad hoc preset kwargs and making provenance serialization part of the approved public contract.
change_log.summary: Add typed preset reference contracts for high-level session, known-news, and market-profile configuration.

change_log.rationale: Calibration now exposes a public preset registry with bundled runtime artifacts, deterministic export, and user-defined preset loading, so the approved Python contract snapshot must include the new registry types, preset artifact metadata, and resolved export surface.
change_log.summary: Add bundled preset registry, artifact metadata, and deterministic preset export contracts.

change_log.rationale: Calibration now exposes one resolved preset-workflow configuration with component-level provenance, deterministic override fields, inferred-session diagnostics, and explicit known-news recommendation outcomes, so the approved Python API snapshot must include the new resolution contracts and entrypoint.
change_log.summary: Add canonical resolved preset-workflow configuration contracts and resolution diagnostics.

change_log.rationale: Calibration now exposes a default estimator-model-report object model on top of the canonical market-data preparation and staged runner path, so the approved Python API snapshot must include the new high-level fit classes under janiform.calibration.

change_log.rationale: The high-level fit surface now lives in a private implementation module whose name reflects its actual role, so the approved API snapshot must update the recorded origin metadata for the public calibration fit classes.

change_log.summary: Remove the lazy simulation alias for the pricing-owned GammaSeverityMarkConfiguration.

change_log.rationale: The simulation namespace now exposes janiform.simulation.coarse, janiform.simulation.seeded, and janiform.simulation.shared as the supported discoverable package map while removing the old underscore-backed structure, so the approved snapshot must track the new modules and the moved symbol origins.
change_log.summary: Approve simulation subpackage decomposition for coarse, seeded, and shared surfaces.

change_log.rationale: The shared simulation package now keeps helper machinery out of its __init__ facade, so the approved snapshot must record that the public validation error type is defined in janiform.simulation.shared.errors while remaining re-exported from janiform.simulation.shared and janiform.simulation.seeded.

change_log.rationale: The public seeded simulation convenience surface now re-exports the public calendar and hourly-factor types referenced by load_hourly_factor_contract_for_simulation so callers can follow the helper signature directly from janiform.simulation or janiform.simulation.seeded without dropping into separate modules first.

change_log.rationale: Calibration now exposes supported fit, market_data, staged, presets, and sessions submodules while keeping janiform.calibration as a curated convenience root, so the approved contract snapshot must track both the root and the new ownership paths.
change_log.summary: Approve calibration public submodule decomposition.

change_log.rationale: Calibration now exposes supported ownership submodules for fit, market-data, presets, sessions, and staged execution, so the approved contract snapshot must track those explicit import paths instead of only the package roots.

change_log.rationale: Staged calibration ownership now lives in explicit inputs, results, and runtime modules instead of hidden private monoliths, so the approved snapshot must reflect the deeper public submodule map and the reduced runtime surface.
change_log.summary: Split staged calibration into public input, result, and runtime ownership modules.

change_log.rationale: The public namespace policy already treats janiform.cli and its documented command and parsing submodules as supported imports, so the approved snapshot must track those modules directly instead of leaving the CLI surface outside the real contract guardrail.
change_log.summary: Track supported CLI modules in the public API contract snapshot.

change_log.rationale: The CLI redesign replaces the old calibration, simulation, and fit-and-simulate roots with the canonical fit and simulate workflow tree, so the approved public API snapshot must remove the deleted CLI symbols and record the new command identifiers that now define the supported surface.

change_log.rationale: The high-level fit surface now defaults the common tick-data path internally and the CLI exposes the beginner inspect/explain flow, so the approved snapshot must record the relaxed JaniformEstimator constructor plus the new fit-inspect CLI constants instead of preserving the older contract-shaped minimum path.

change_log.rationale: The first-use workflow reset makes fit, simulate, and price one coherent family with durable CLI outputs, interval-driven simulation, model-driven pricing, and explicit library output-path plus silent controls, so the approved snapshot must track the new workflow method signatures and the renamed CLI pricing constants instead of preserving the execution-input-first contract.

change_log.rationale: The high-level simulation surface now returns a Janiform-owned result object with native tabular export helpers while preserving workflow diagnostics and metadata instead of exposing the raw coarse or seeded payloads directly.
